{{< include ../../latex-macros/macros.qmd >}}

This is the note sheet that comes printed with Midterm 1.
You may not bring your own notes,
so study with this sheet.
It summarizes the definitions, laws and notation that the exam uses.
The full definitions, with examples, are in the [notes](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mcs/),
and the sheet leaves out some of the notes' results.

::: {.content-visible when-format="html"}
To print it, download the [PDF](midterm-1.pdf).
:::
